title: vb6-archaeology kit configuration
description: Protected source trees, output directories and analysis hints. Validate with `python -m tools config-check`.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, for editor validation.

protected_source_dirs.description: In-repo directory names holding immutable VB6 originals. Hooks deny writes into them. Empty is valid when the originals live outside the repo (use protected_path_markers).

protected_path_markers.description: Path segments that are read-only wherever they appear, including outside the repo (e.g. an originals folder on a share).

default_source_dir.description: In-repo directory searched first when a tool needs the originals. Empty when the originals live outside the repo.

extracts_dir.description: Where extract writes analysis copies (default working/extracts).

default_extract.description: Extract folder name used when --extract is omitted and several exist. Empty means require an explicit choice.

skeletons_dir.description: Where form skeleton JSON is written (consumers may point this at a web lib dir).

encoding.description: Primary VB6 source encoding (cp932 for Japanese projects).

encoding_fallbacks.description: Encodings tried when the primary decode fails.

reports_http_port.description: Loopback port used by `python -m tools serve`.

scan_skip_dirs.description: Directory names scan-chars never descends into. Protected dirs and markers are skipped automatically on top of this list.

mdi_defaults.description: Consumer-only: MDI window and Picture1 heights emitted as mdiDefaults in runtime-layout.json. Empty means the key is left out.

mdi_chrome.description: Consumer-only: MDI shell VB_Name(s) and chrome control names for runtime_layout. Kit default is empty — set shell_forms/control_names in the consumer config (common example: MDIForm1 + Picture1/FG1/fg2).

shell_forms.description: MDI shell form VB_Name(s). Empty = no shell-name chrome attribution.

control_names.description: Controls treated as MDI chrome (matched case-insensitively as path segments). Empty = no control-name chrome.

geometry_hints.description: FormName -> twips box, used when resolving parent-relative runtime expressions.

deep_read_name_map.description: VB_Name -> output key override for deep-read (empty means lowercase VB_Name).

layout_sub_scores.description: Lowercase Sub name -> open-path score for layout. Keep app-specific openers in the consumer config.

picture1_height_by_sub.description: Consumer-only: lowercase Sub -> Form VB_Name for Picture1.Height attribution.

verify_report_allow_files.description: Consumer-only: basenames verify-names accepts beyond the inventory.

notes.description: Free-form human notes kept next to the settings they explain.
